title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Wrexham, you will manage customer accounts within the Industrial / Manufacturing sector, helping the finance function keep records accurate and payments on track. You will handle day-to-day credit control work and provide clear account information that helps the business run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial & Manufacturing sector in Wrexham. They are fairly well known in the area and have a strong reputation.

Description
- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and maintain accurate account records.
- Contact customers to follow up on outstanding payments and agree practical next steps.
- Review aged debt reports and prioritise accounts that need timely action.
- Investigate payment queries and work with relevant colleagues to resolve them.
- Keep clear notes of customer contact, payment promises and account updates.
- Issue customer statements and provide information on account balances when needed.
- Reconcile customer payments against invoices to keep records up to date.
- Share regular debt updates with the Accounting & Finance department to support informed decisions.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience managing customer accounts and following up overdue payments.
- Confidence reviewing account balances, invoices and payment information.
- Ability to investigate payment queries and keep account records accurate.
- Clear written and verbal communication when dealing with customers.
- Good attention to detail when recording payment activity and account updates.
- Ability to organise workload and prioritise outstanding debt effectively.

Job Offer
- Permanent Credit Controller position based in Wrexham.
- Salary of 27,000 to 33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Excellent benefits package including enhanced pension and private healthcare.
- Really accessible location with plenty of free parking on site and close to local public transport routes.
- Full time role - 37.5 hours per week.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
Care Coordinator

Colwyn Bay

27000 - 30000 Negotiable on experience

The Company

This well respected organisation are currently rated at Excellent in all sections by CIW, Received 5 star Workbuzz employer award 2025

They are seeking a motivated and professional Care Coordinator to join their growing domiciliary care team in North Wales. This is a varied and rewarding role where you will play a vital part in ensuring the clients receive safe, high-quality, person-centred care whilst supporting our team of Care Professionals.

The Role

As a Care Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing care schedules, undertaking client reviews, supporting compliance activities, and participating in the management on-call rota. (1 week in every 8 weeks)

Duties include:

Scheduling & Coordination
- Creating and maintaining efficient staff rotas and schedules.
- Matching Care Professionals to clients based on skills, availability and continuity of care.
- Ensuring all care visits are covered and delivered safely.
- Responding to daily operational challenges and schedule changes.
- Monitoring visit delivery and addressing any missed or late calls.

Client Reviews & Quality Assurance
- Conducting regular care reviews with clients and their families.
- Supporting the development and updating of care plans and risk assessments.
- Building strong relationships with clients to ensure exceptional service delivery.
- Following up on client feedback and resolving concerns professionally.
- Ensuring care remains personalised and responsive to changing needs.

Compliance & Administration
- Maintaining accurate care records and documentation.
- Supporting quality assurance audits and compliance monitoring.
- Ensuring staff training, supervision and certification records remain up to date.
- Assisting with safeguarding, incident reporting and regulatory requirements.
- Supporting the Registered Manager during inspections and audits.
- Participating in a rota-based on-call service covering evenings, weekends and bank holidays.

Requirements
- Experience working within Health and Social Care
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication and problem-solving abilities
- Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritise effectively
- Good computer literacy and experience using Microsoft Office
- Full UK Driving Licence and access to a vehicle
- Willingness to participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota
- A genuine commitment to delivering outstanding care

Desirable

Previous experience in a Care Coordinator or Scheduler role

Level 3 Health & Social Care qualification (or working towards)

Experience within domiciliary care

Knowledge of CIW regulations and care sector compliance requirements

In Return

Company are offering:

Competitive salary based on experience, Additional on-call payments based on 1 in every 8 weeks, Annual allowance 31 days inclusive of Bank Holidays, Ongoing training and professional development, Career progression opportunities, Supportive and friendly working environment, Company pension scheme, Employee wellbeing support, The opportunity to make a real difference in your local community

Benefits

Company pension, Employee discount, On-site parking, Paid training, Referral programme
